name: Ship Panic
hook: Shout the orders. Flip the switches. Don't explode.
how: Your screen shows orders for someone else's panel: shout them out. Their screens show orders for yours. Fix enough in time to warp to the next sector; every miss cracks the hull, and each sector is faster.
controls: Click or tap switches, dials and buttons, drag sliders; SHOUT (or Space) reads your order to the crew
uses: The host's browser makes every order, sends it to someone else's screen and checks the panels; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats: they shout their orders and work their own panels, a little slowly.
Every switch you flip shows up for the crew at once.
The most orders your crew fixed in one flight.
ideas: Add a meteor shower that shakes everyone's screen
Make it a submarine instead of a spaceship
Add a control that has to be held down
